newsitem.title: TURKEY: Egyptian ship runs aground in Turkey's Bosphorus.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian ship runs aground in Turkey's Bosphorus.

text.p: An Egyptian-flagged cargo ship carrying sunflowers has struck an offshore lighthouse and run aground in Istanbul's Bosphorus strait, Turkey's Anatolian news agency said on Tuesday.

It said the 3,415-tonne Lady Dotic, on the way from Ukraine to Egypt, was sitting on a sandbank 200 metres (yards) from the shore after hitting the small lighthouse in the strait on Monday night and taking in water.
There were no injuries in the incident, the agency said. It did not say if traffic through the Bosphorus, one of the world's busiest waterways, was affected.
